profile.reading:
Meta's Richland Parish Data Center near Holly Ridge in northeast Louisiana houses Hyperion, which Meta calls its largest multi-gigawatt AI training cluster. Construction began in December 2024. On 13 July 2026 Meta said it was expanding the site to 5 GW of compute capacity, the largest in its fleet, with investment of more than $50 billion, up from an original design of about 2 GW.

Power comes through Entergy Louisiana. The Louisiana Public Service Commission approved three combined-cycle gas plants for the project in August 2025, and a revised agreement in 2026 adds seven more gas plants, grid-scale batteries at three sites and solar capacity. Meta says it pays the full cost of energy and related infrastructure.

The 5 GW figure is Meta's stated plan. Coordinates are from the site's Wikipedia entry, which cites Meta's data center page.

profile.capacity_note: 5 GW is Meta's stated compute capacity at full build; about 2 GW is its original design. Plans, not measured load.
